lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base-to-wall-4 90 deg fold. Sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the outer-skin apex (outermost point on the bisector is at -0.04 to 0.00 mm). The line runs t=0..100.5 and the outer arc runs t=-1..101 (wall ends). Parallel.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Base-to-wall-5 fold. The extent override (100.5 mm) is justified: an outer-apex point trace finds the arc continuous over t=0..101 despite the outer-base dropout. Sections show the line on the outer apex within 0.02 mm.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Base-to-wall-6 fold. The 94.4 mm override matches the arc, which is present at t=-1..95. On the outer apex within 0.02 mm at all three sections.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Base-to-wall-7 fold. The arc runs t=-1..96 and the line runs 0..94.3. On the outer apex within 0.02 mm.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Wall 4 to its narrow (~5 mm) outward top flange, 90 deg. On the outer apex within 0.02 mm. The close-up shows the line spanning the whole wall-4 fold (x -50..50 vs fold -51..51). Apex hits beyond the ends come from the coplanar flat tabs of the wide flanges, not a fold.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Wall 5/10 to its narrow outward top flange, 90 deg. On the outer apex within 0.03 mm at 25/50/75%. Spans the full fold; scatter at the 50% station is flange-edge noise inside the bend.

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Wall 6/8 to its wide holed outward top flange, 90 deg. On the outer apex within 0.05 mm. The fold runs along the wall length (t=-1..97 vs line 0..95.5); the flange tabs beyond the wall are flat.

lines.label: B8
lines.reason: Wall 7/9 to its wide holed outward top flange, 90 deg. On the outer apex within 0.04 mm. Covers the full fold along the wall.
